title: Steam Machine: 2TB waitlist closed, 512GB on sale
subject: steammachine
description:
Would you still buy one at this price? 👇

Valve has opened direct purchases of the 512GB Steam Machine while supplies last and closed the 2TB waitlist, citing rising memory and storage costs. More details are expected in January.

Sources: Valve Steam Hardware announcement via GamesRadar+ (Nov 19, 2026), GamingOnLinux (Nov 19, 2026), Notebookcheck (Nov 19, 2026), Tom's Hardware

scenes.text: You can finally just buy a Steam Machine.
On November 19, Valve switched the 512GB model to add to cart, after filling every reservation.
The 2TB model went the other way. Valve closed its waitlist, because more people are on it than there are units.
The reason is memory and storage. Valve says those costs keep rising at unprecedented levels.
scenes.search: computer ram memory chips close up

scenes.text: It launched at $1,049. Valve doesn't know yet how many more it can build, or at what price, and expects to share more in January.
